description: Participants will generate creative artworks using AI tools such as Midjourney, DALL·E, or Stable Diffusion. The challenge focuses on imagination, unique prompts, and artistic expression using artificial intelligence.
Developers will build a fully functional responsive website within a short timeframe. Designs, performance, mobile responsiveness, and code quality will be evaluated.
Photographers capture their most creative shot based on a theme. Focus, lighting, composition, and storytelling will be key judging factors.
Designers will create a visually stunning poster or banner using their preferred tools. Creativity, layout, color balance, and originality will be judged.
Participants solve algorithmic and data-structure challenges under time pressure. Accuracy and efficiency play major roles in scoring.
Design a clean, modern mobile app interface focusing on usability and user experience. Flow, spacing, and visual hierarchy are key.
Create a unique and meaningful logo for a fictional or real brand. Judges will consider symbolism, simplicity, and identity.
Create a storyboard for a short film based on a provided theme. Creativity in visual storytelling is highly encouraged.
Participants create a detailed 3D model using Blender, Maya, or any similar tool. Judges evaluate quality, detailing, and accuracy.
Artists paint a digital artwork with emotional depth and creative expression. Brushwork, concept, and color harmony will be reviewed.
Design a promotional advertisement poster for a trending product. Judges look for clarity, message delivery, and design appeal.
Participants build and simulate a robot completing an assigned task. Creativity and technical accuracy matter the most.
Writers craft a creative story or descriptive piece based on the given theme. Originality and writing flow determine the winner.
Solve various mind-bending puzzles and logic challenges. Participants are ranked based on accuracy and time.
Create a short 2D animation using frame-by-frame techniques. Smoothness, creativity, and storytelling are evaluated.
Participants remix a provided audio track into a unique musical composition. Creativity and sound design quality matter most.
Design a user interface for a fictional adventure game. Judges review layout, theme consistency, and user experience.
Creators make a fun, entertaining, or storytelling reel within the given time. Creativity and editing skills are key.
Participants pitch an innovative startup idea with a real-world solution. Creativity, impact, and presentation skills are evaluated.
Create a working or conceptual science model that demonstrates a scientific principle. Judges review accuracy and creativity.
